decision: Determine whether a question-specific answer schema removes V1 representation failures without reducing semantic accuracy or evidence binding.

schedule.order: For each trial, run the citation baseline first and the schema condition second using the same seeded case order.

metrics.success_threshold: The schema condition must improve semantic accuracy, improve typed-contract validity by at least 10 percentage points, and reduce evidence binding by no more than 2 percentage points.

privacy: Only already-public evidence packets are sent. Raw provider responses must remain outside the repository and OneDrive.
limitations: The two slices were selected after V1 exposed their representation failures, so this is a targeted replication rather than an untouched holdout.
Three trials estimate repeatability but do not support broad statistical generalization beyond these questions and this model.
